_readme: REVIEW 2026-08-25: placeholder rows removed pre-prod (11 'Untitled' slots all played the same file — all three review personas called it disqualifying). The 12-track layout is proven and returns row by row as real tracks land: add {src,title,note,year,duration,peaks} objects here. 2026-09-09: each track is a CASSETTE — its label colour is decided from the title (see tapeTint in StudioOne.astro); set `tint` to pin a tape (an oklch() colour keeps its place in the shelf's hue spacing; any other CSS colour is used as-is), and `cover` (an image path) prints on the label instead of the flat colour. 2026-09-22: the set re-cut from Jon's Look·Listen bench — tapes live under public/listen/<slug>.mp3 (256k), peaks via scripts/gen-peaks.mjs; a track with src null is a RESERVED SLOT (holds its place in the order, filtered out of the build until its file lands). Labels: `cover` = public/listen/<slug>-label.webp, Jon's own 2000×833 (2.4:1, the label's aspect) — it prints on the big tape and on the wallet's minis.
